page.overview:
Who is Dalevien?

Dalevien is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Dalevien is stocky with short, dark hair streaked with gray. Her appearance hints that she might be just over 150, as with some sisters with streaks of gray in their hair, like Verin Mathwin and Dagdara Finchey.

Dalevien and Felaana Bevaine are maintaining a shield on Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the Tower cells. Dalevien is comparing the text between two books, barely registering Egwene's arrival.

Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
